companyFieldUpdates.description: CARMA Corp. provides utility submetering, billing, collections, consumption reporting and on-site technical services for multi-residential, commercial and institutional properties. The company traces its predecessor operations to 1977 and was formed as CARMA Corp. through the August 2019 amalgamation of Carma Industries Inc. and Carma Billing Services Inc. CVC DIF agreed to acquire CARMA from TerraNova through DIF Infrastructure VIII on September 15, 2025, and industry-association reporting confirms the sale closed in December 2025. The disclosed acquisition vehicle is DIF Infra 8 Canada Holdco 2 Ltd.; the exact closing day, acquired stake and any management or family rollover are not publicly disclosed. CARMA operated more than 135,000 units across more than 1,000 buildings at signing and was reported to have approximately 350,000 meters installed across North America by June 2026. Spectrum, Priority Submetering, Undercurrent and Greensource remain operating businesses beneath CARMA rather than separate manager-level PortCos. No later sale or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.
